plain: The belief in rule by elected representatives rather than a king

webster.text: A republican form or system of government.

more.text: Attachment to a republican form of government.

example.quote: means of preserving and protecting the principles of republicanism, will be found in that very system which is now exclaimed against as the parent of oppression.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
